section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes Study 1, which examined the factor structure of a Malay version of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) using a community sample of 591 women in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The study found a two-factor structure ('General Body Appreciation' and 'Body Image Investment') that was invariant across Malaysian Malay and Chinese women, with General Body Appreciation showing a significant negative correlation with body mass index.
